question: In September 2025, which company did BCCI announce as Team India’s new lead sponsor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Apollo Tyres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **September 2025**, the **Board of Control for Cricket in India** (**BCCI**) officially announced **Apollo Tyres** as the new **Lead Sponsor** for **Team India** across all formats.
 
• As the **Lead Sponsor**, the **Apollo Tyres** logo will be prominently displayed on the front of the **Indian National Cricket Team** jerseys for **Test** matches, **One Day Internationals** (**ODI**), and **T20 Internationals** (**T20I**).
 
• This partnership marks a significant transition in the commercial ecosystem of **Indian Cricket**, as **Apollo Tyres** takes over the position previously held by **Dream11**.
